classification: Five-task exploratory fresh holdout; not GA certification alone
rules: Selection fixed by sorted task IDs and seeded shuffle before any results.
Every selected task must prepare and pass preflight before paid calls.
Freeze implementation, model, images and budgets for all ten runs.
Keep failed, missing and ungraded samples in the denominator.
No per-task retries or replacement tasks.
Only public task material reaches models; independent official grader judges imported patches.
Report the entire cohort; do not infer GA from one passing task or adjust acceptance after results.
